agents.description: Array containing all RCS agents available for your account.

agents[].id.description: The unique ID of the agent.

agents[].display_name.description: The display name of the agent visible to the recipient.

agents[].status.description: The current status of the agent. Possible values: pending, test, launched, approved.

agents[].created.description: Creation date of the agent in the format yyyy-mm-dd hh:ii:ss.

agents[].is_generic.description: Indicates whether this is a generic agent.
